heading.en: Ammon glories in the Lord—The faithful are strengthened by the Lord and are given knowledge—By faith men may bring thousands of souls unto repentance—God has all power and comprehends all things. About 90–77 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua olioli Amona i le Alii—E faamalosi e le Alii ē faamaoni ma tuuina mai ia te i latou le malamalama—O le faatuatua e mafai ai e tagata ona aumaia le afe ma afe o agaga i le salamo—Ua i ai i le Atua le mana uma ma ua ia silafia mea uma. E tusa o le 90–77 T.L.M.

w.en: these are the words of Ammon
in the hands of the Lord
out of the land of Zarahemla,
And it came to pass that
even as it hath been given
